detailZh: F1卡塔尔大奖赛：乔治·拉塞尔击败安东内利夺得杆位
乔治·拉塞尔在2026年第六次夺得杆位，梅赛德斯车队在F1卡塔尔大奖赛的预赛中全面领先。
乔治·拉塞尔在F1卡塔尔大奖赛中夺得杆位，击败队友安东内利，梅赛德斯车队在多哈的比赛中全面领先。
在卢塞尔赛道的高下压力赛道上，梅赛德斯车队在周末的每一节练习中都证明了自己比竞争对手更胜一筹，并通过利用其转向优势锁定了前两排。
拉塞尔在决定性的Q3冲刺赛中，在第一轮和第二轮中分别跑出1m21.695s的成绩，领先他的世界冠军队友近两十分，并且明显领先其他竞争者。
安东内利质疑自己为何在最后一轮中排在第一位，这位意大利少年在第二次尝试中找不到任何改进，最终排名第二。拉塞尔几乎复制了他的第一次成绩，但无需改进就赢得了他本赛季第六个杆位，这对于他的成长之旅意义重大。
迈凯轮的兰多·诺里斯在第二轮中提高了十分，以第三名的成绩领先队友奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里，而伊萨克·哈吉亚在排位赛中击败了他的红牛队友马克斯·维斯塔潘，获得了第五个发车位。
法拉利在多哈的糟糕周末继续，整个练习赛中都在为抓地力和速度而挣扎。查尔斯·勒克莱尔只能排在第七位，距离杆位有1.260秒的差距。青训车队小红牛的菜鸟车手阿维德·林德布拉德击败了刘易斯·汉密尔顿的第二辆法拉利，利亚姆·劳森以第十名的成绩结束了前十。
红牛车队在Q2的表现与梅赛德斯车队相当接近，哈德贾的成绩为1m22.344s，比领跑者拉塞尔慢不到三十分之一，拉塞尔以1m22.079s的成绩领先安东内利。
在这两支车队和梅赛德斯车队之后，法拉利再次陷入困境，勒克莱尔落后整整一秒，他们试图与小红牛车队抗衡。
尽管如此，两队仍有足够的余地进入Q3。对于前十名的争夺，哈斯、阿尔派和奥迪之间的竞争非常激烈，但最终这三支车队都没有足够的实力去威胁排名第十的劳森。
奥利弗·贝尔曼最接近，只差0.240s未能晋级。皮埃尔·加斯利从FP2中失去的时间中恢复过来，在发车位上获得第十二名，随后是加布里埃尔·博托莱托和他的队友弗朗哥·科拉平托。哈斯车队的新人拉斐尔·卡马拉和经验丰富的尼科·胡肯伯格将在周日的第八排发车。
梅赛德斯和红牛是唯一两支在Q1中只完成了一圈计时圈速的车队，拉塞尔的1分22.557秒领先，排在安东内利和维斯塔潘之前。其他领跑者虽然也在磨损的轮胎上完成了一圈，但同样也为稍后保留了关键的软胎。
第一轮练习结束后，卡洛斯·塞恩斯和亚历克斯·阿隆诺在圈外观望，威廉姆斯车手在第二轮练习后仍保持在这个位置。这对科拉平托来说是个安慰，他凭借0.1秒的优势从第16位惊险晋级Q1。与此同时，哈斯车队的新人卡马拉也晋级到第14位，但他为此不得不使用第二套软胎。
费尔南多·阿隆索和兰斯·斯特罗尔分别以第19位和第20位为陷入困境的阿斯顿·马丁车队挣扎，凯迪拉克车队的瓦尔特里·博塔斯和塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯完成了周日的排位赛。
detailEn: F1 Qatar GP: George Russell beats Kimi Antonelli to pole
George Russell takes sixth pole of 2026 as Mercedes dominates qualifying at Formula 1's Qatar Grand Prix
George Russell has grabbed an emphatic pole for Formula 1's Qatar Grand Prix, defeating team-mate Kimi Antonelli as Mercedes blitzed the competition in Doha.

On the demanding, high-downforce circuit of Lusail, Mercedes proved a step ahead of the competition in every session over the weekend, and the Silver Arrows capitalised on their cornering advantage by locking out the front row.
Russell led from Antonelli after the first of two runs in the decisive Q3 shootout with a 1m21.695s lap, nearly two tenths up on his world champion team-mate and well clear of the competition.

As Antonelli questioned being out first in the queue for the final runs, the Italian teenager struggled to find any improvement on his second attempt and settled for second. Russell almost matched his first run, but did not need to improve to claim his sixth pole of a character-building campaign.
McLaren's Lando Norris found a tenth on his second lap to claim third ahead of team-mate Oscar Piastri, with Isack Hadjar out-qualifying his Red Bull team-mate Max Verstappen for fifth on the grid.

Ferrari continued a woeful weekend in Doha, having been struggling for grip and pace throughout practice. Charles Leclerc could only manage seventh on the grid, a shocking 1.260s off pole. Racing Bulls rookie Arvid Lindblad beat the second Ferrari of Lewis Hamilton to eighth, with Liam Lawson rounding out the top 10.
Red Bull, rather than McLaren, looked somewhat close to Mercedes in Q2, with Hadjar's 1m22.344s less than three tenths behind pacesetter Russell, who had the edge on Antonelli with a 1m22.079s lap.
Behind those two teams and McLaren, Ferrari struggled again, with Leclerc a full second behind as they looked to fight with Racing Bulls.

There was still a big enough cushion for both teams to make it into Q3, though. The battle for the top-10 was a tight fight between Haas, Alpine and Audi, but ultimately none of the three teams had enough in the tank to bother 10th-placed Lawson.

Oliver Bearman came closest, missing the cut by 0.240s. Pierre Gasly recovered from lost track time in FP2 to take 12th on the grid, followed by Gabriel Bortoleto and team-mate Franco Colapinto. Haas rookie Rafael Camara and veteran Nico Hulkenberg will start from the eighth row on Sunday.

Mercedes and Red Bull were the only two teams to just set one timed lap in Q1, with Russell's 1m22.557s leading the way ahead of Antonelli and Verstappen. The other frontrunners set a second time on scrubbed tyres, though, equally saving crucial sets of softs for later on.

After the first set of runs, Carlos Sainz and Alex Albon were on the outside looking in and the Williams drivers stayed in those positions after the second effort. That was a relief for Colapinto, who escaped Q1 by a tenth of a second in 16th. Meanwhile, Haas rookie Camara also advanced in 14th, but had to deploy a second set of softs to do so in 14th.
Fernando Alonso and Lance Stroll were 19th and 20th for struggling Aston Martin, with Cadillac duo Valtteri Bottas and Sergio Perez completing Sunday's grid.

George Russell produced a superb performance in Qatar Grand Prix Qualifying to beat his Mercedes team-mate Kimi Antonelli to pole position.

The reignition of Russell's feud with Max Verstappen at last weekend's Las Vegas Grand Prix had dominated the build-up to the penultimate race of the season, but the Brit produced the perfect response as he topped all three parts of qualifying.

That came as a surprise after Antonelli, who sealed the drivers' title with four rounds to spare, had topped all three practice sessions, but the Italian was unable to match Russell when it mattered most.

items.originalTitle: Antonelli and Mercedes sweep Qatar GP practice
detailZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
在排位赛前的20分钟内，练习赛中的圈数非常少。似乎很少有车手能在他们的第一次排位赛中取得更好的成绩。
安东内利的队友乔治·拉塞尔在第二阶段的表现中保持了领先，尽管他在著名的14号弯角发生了一次打滑，那里的地板损坏总是令人担忧，这使安东内利得以缩小到落后0.017秒。
但在第三次尝试中，安东内利全速前进，逆转了排名，领先拉塞尔0.249秒，这个成绩无人能及。
梅赛德斯的车手在任何时刻都落后了半秒左右，红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘在练习结束时排名第三，落后安东内利0.510秒。
维斯塔潘的队友伊萨克·哈德贾排名第四，领先略有提升的法拉利车手查尔斯·勒克莱尔，勒克莱尔在周五的比赛中表现不佳，非常悲观。
勒克莱尔的队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿排名第九，抱怨赛车转向不足，并要求增加前翼角度以避免提前进站。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂在最后一次性能测试跑之前排名第三，但在第六和第七位时被麦凯轮车队的兰多·诺里斯超越，最终排名下降。
皮亚斯特里是众多抱怨转向不足的车手之一。
小红牛在周五表现得非常乐观，并在FP3练习中领跑中游，Arvid Lindblad排名第八，劳森排名第十，领先其中游对手两十分。
阿尔派恩落后小红牛很多，小红牛在车队积分榜上领先Enstone车队27分，争夺第五名。加斯利在FP3练习中排名第14，队友科拉平托排名第16。
科拉平托在最后阶段幸运地避开了高速移动的斯特罗尔，这一事件将在练习结束后进行调查。
在劳森和加斯利之间是奥迪和哈斯车队的奥利·贝尔曼，他的队友拉斐尔·卡马拉排名第15。
费尔南多·阿隆索超越了两辆威廉姆斯赛车，为阿斯顿·马丁赢得了第17名。
凯迪拉克车队以瓦尔特里·博塔斯领先近0.7秒的成绩，排在最后一名塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯之前。

detailEn: Kimi Antonelli completed a hat-trick of practice sweeps in FP3 for the Qatar Grand Prix, as Mercedes' rivals appear to be fighting for the best of the rest with Red Bull taking that honour in third practice.
Very few laps were turned in the first 20 minutes or so, before qualifying runs. It appeared that few drivers could improve on their first qualifying efforts.

Antonelli's team-mate George Russell set the early pace and maintained that lead after the second performance runs despite a wide moment through the notorious Turn 14 - where floor damage is always a worry - and that allowed Antonelli to close in to just 0.017s behind.
But on the third attempts, Antonelli turned on the afterburners to flip the order and lead Russell by 0.249s, which would not be beaten.
Mercedes' challengers were regularly around half a second down at any given point, with Red Bull's Max Verstappen taking third at the end of the session, 0.510s adrift of Antonelli.
Verstappen's team-mate Isack Hadjar took fourth ahead of the slightly improved Ferrari of Charles Leclerc, who was very pessimistic after Friday's running.
Leclerc's team-mate Lewis Hamilton was down in ninth, complaining that the car was not turning in sufficiently and asking for more front wing angle to avoid understeer.
Oscar Piastri had been third before the last performance run attempt, but was jumped by McLaren team-mate Lando Norris as they ran sixth and seventh, shuffled down the order by the end.
Piastri was another of the many drivers complaining of understeer.
Racing Bulls was extremely bullish on Friday and did head the midfield in FP3 with Arvid Lindblad in eighth and Liam Lawson in 10th, two tenths clear of its midfield rivals.

Alpine was well behind Racing Bulls, which is 27 points ahead of the Enstone team in the chase for fifth in the constructors' standings. Pierre Gasly finished 14th and team-mate Franco Colapinto 16th in FP3.
Colapinto was lucky to avoid a slow-moving Lance Stroll at high speed in the closing stages and that incident will be investigated after the session.
Between Lawson and Gasly were the Audis and Haas driver Ollie Bearman, whose team-mate Rafael Camara finished 15th.
Fernando Alonso cleared both Williams to take 17th for Aston Martin.
Cadillac anchored the order with Valtteri Bottas nearly 0.7s ahead of last-place Sergio Perez.

detailZh: F1卡塔尔大奖赛：Kimi安东内利完成排位赛练习全胜，梅赛德斯占据巨大优势
Kimi安东内利和乔治·拉塞尔在F1卡塔尔大奖赛的最后一场练习赛中展示了梅赛德斯车队的强大实力
Kimi安东内利为梅赛德斯车队在卡塔尔大奖赛的练习赛中赢得了全胜，银箭车队带着巨大优势进入排位赛
乔治·拉塞尔在半程之前速度最快，各车队开始进行软胎测试，但安东内利在下半场再次缩短了圈速
不同于周五两次红旗的FP2练习，第三场练习没有发生任何事故，这在很大程度上要归功于一个平淡的开局，早期几乎没有动作。一开始，皮埃尔·加斯利独自一人绕赛道行驶，这是在周五第二场练习中他的阿尔派赛车在中途翻车后，弥补失去的地盘。
加斯利最终被队友弗朗哥·科拉平托和凯迪拉克的瓦尔特里·博塔加入，而其他人则在练习的前三分之一时间里待在维修区。
但在20分钟之前，情况突然发生了变化，重量级的赛车手们开始了软胎的练习——这种轮胎预计只对排位赛有用。比赛预计将在中胎和硬胎的Pirelli轮胎上完成，这些轮胎在卢塞尔赛道上面临最严峻的周末。随着排位赛模拟的开始，即将离任的世界冠军兰多·诺里斯在遭遇剧烈的过度转向后，驶向了14号弯的逃生道路。
正如周五两次练习的情况一样，梅赛德斯车队立即掌控了局面，乔治·拉塞尔以1分22.983秒的成绩领先队友基米·安东内利。这比麦克拉伦的奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂和马克斯·维斯塔潘能做出的成绩快了半秒以上，后者驾驶的雷诺红牛小红牛22赛车在更艰难的自由练习后需要重新平衡。
虽然拉塞尔随后在5号弯道漂移过宽，安东内利的第二次中期练习跑出的成绩几乎与队友相同，仅慢了0.017秒。
在还剩15分钟的时候，维斯塔潘短暂地占据了领先位置，但安东内利立即反击，并以1分22.400秒的成绩为梅赛德斯车队恢复了半秒的领先优势。拉塞尔对此速度的爆发毫无应对之策，落后了0.249秒。
维斯塔潘仍然排在第三位，作为第一辆非梅赛德斯车队赛车，落后0.501秒，其后是他的队友伊萨克·哈德贾。
在查尔斯·勒克莱尔将其描述为“非常困难”的周五之后，法拉利车队几乎没有取得进步，勒克莱尔排名第五，落后安东内利八十分之一秒。迈凯轮车队的表现也超过了预期，诺里斯排名第六，皮亚斯特里排名第七。
汉密尔顿在最后的练习圈中被交通堵塞，表现不如预期，最终在第九位完成了比赛，分开了小红牛的中场领跑者阿维德·林德布拉德和利亚姆·劳森。
detailEn: F1 Qatar GP: Kimi Antonelli completes practice clean sweep as Mercedes dominates
Kimi Antonelli and George Russell showcase Mercedes' dominant form in final practice for Formula 1's Qatar Grand Prix
Kimi Antonelli has handed Mercedes a clean sweep of Qatar GP practice sessions as the Silver Arrows head to qualifying with a huge advantage.

Russell went quickest before halfway as teams embarked on soft-tyre runs with Mercedes continuing its ominous form on the high-downforce motorcycle circuit of Lusail, only for Antonelli to take another chunk out of that laptime in the second half.

Unlike Friday's twice red-flagged FP2 session, third practice took place without incident, which was partly thanks to a tepid start with little to no action early on. At the start, Pierre Gasly circulated by himself, making up for lost ground after beaching his Alpine in the gravel midway through Friday's second practice.
Gasly was eventually joined by team-mate Franco Colapinto and Cadillac's Valtteri Bottas, while the others stayed in the garage for the first third of the session.

That all changed suddenly before the 20-minute mark as the heavy hitters embarked on soft-tyre runs - a compound projected to be only useful for qualifying. The race is expected to be completed on medium and hard Pirelli tyres, which are facing their most demanding weekend on the Lusail loop. As qualifying simulations got underway, outgoing world champion Lando Norris headed to the Turn 14 escape road after catching a violent snap of oversteer.

As was the case during both of Friday's practice endeavours, Mercedes immediately took charge with George Russell's 1m22.983s leading team-mate Kimi Antonelli. That was over half a second better than what McLaren's Oscar Piastri and Max Verstappen could muster, the latter driving a Red Bull RB22 which required rebalancing after a tougher free practice outing.
While Russell then drifted wide in Turn 5, Antonelli's second mid-session run yielded a time almost identical to his team-mate's, just 0.017s off.

With 15 minutes to go, Verstappen briefly claimed top before Antonelli immediately retaliated and restored Mercedes' comfortable half-second cushion with a 1m22.400s effort. Russell had no answer for that flash of pace, conceding 0.249s.
Verstappen remained third, a sobering 0.501s in arrears as the first non-Mercedes car, followed by team-mate Isack Hadjar.

After a Friday which Charles Leclerc described as "very difficult", there was little progress for Ferrari as Leclerc took fifth, eight tenths behind Antonelli. McLaren also struggled more than was expected with sixth for Norris and seventh for Piastri.
Lewis Hamilton fared worse after being held up by traffic on his final hotlap, splitting Racing Bull's midfield leaders Arvid Lindblad and Liam Lawson in ninth.

items.originalTitle: FIA explores DRS return alongside push-to-pass system for F1’s V8 engines
detailZh: 国际汽联探索在F1 V8引擎中恢复DRS系统并推动通过系统
独家对Motorsport.com发表谈话，国际汽联单座赛车总监Nikolas Tombazis透露了管理机构如何能在2030年结合空气动力学和电气超越辅助系统
上周宣布的框架确立了下个一级方程式动力单元法规的关键要素——一个2.1升涡轮增压V8，其电气组件显著减少——但在接下来的几个月里，仍有许多细节需要完善
其中关键未解决的问题是如何促进超越。对于2026年，国际汽联引入了超越模式，但这主要是由于这套规则设定极其复杂的结果。
为了使当前的动力单元规定能够有效实施，汽车需要具有显著更低的阻力，这就是为什么引入了带有直线模式区域的主动空气动力学。由于每位车手都可以打开前后翼片，DRS作为超越辅助工具消失了，国际汽联不得不提出一个替代方案，结果就是超越模式。
目标是使下一轮规则周期中的整个概念大大简化。国际汽联单座赛车总监尼科拉斯·托马齐斯在接受Motorsport.com独家采访时确认，直线模式（SM）区域将消失，并且管理机构正在研究更熟悉的概念。
幕后，目前正在努力确定从2030年起在超越辅助工具方面需要什么。国际汽联正在调查几个选项，包括推杆加速和DRS的组合。
“在比赛条件下，电能将肯定更多地集中在推杆加速上，而较少地集中在能量回收上。由于与当前引擎相比，电能部分在尺寸上会小得多，这意味着所有与能量使用相关的规定都将被消除或大幅简化，”托马齐斯告诉Motorsport.com。
“所以是的，这将是超车的基本点，但我们仍在进行超车和近距离比赛的模拟。”
“这些模拟旨在确定在推杆加速方面需要什么——是像IndyCar那样的每场比赛固定秒数，还是不同的系统——以及是否需要与DRS的回归相结合。”
“如果我们需要添加DRS并与一些电气部件一起使用，我们将非常乐意这样做，”Tombazis说。”
“只是想说明：在下一项规定下，我们不再需要SM模式区域，因此我们将保留拥有更多类似DRS的设备来补充电气部件的选项，以确保我们有正确的近距离比赛水平。”
机械师正在对马克斯·维斯塔潘的小红牛18赛车DRS系统进行维修
虽然正在进行模拟，但尚未确认推杆和DRS是否会真正结合，尽管托马齐斯确认这种结合现在已经在考虑之中。
“可能会，是的。我没有说它将完全那样，但确实可能会有DRS和推杆两种功能。”
根据最初的提案，电气组件将提供高达200kW的动力，其中100kW用于正常使用，另外100kW用于推杆加速。
通过可能将DRS添加到其中，国际汽联希望找到正确的平衡：超车动作理想情况下应该再次在刹车区域完成，而不是在直道的一半处。
"是的，我想说的是，DRS是解决这个问题的已知方案。这不像是我们需要发明的东西。我们只需要看看，A，我们是否需要它，B，我们需要多少。"
"我们显然不希望出现一种情况，即汽车毫无竞争地飞驰而过，我们希望有比赛。我们希望汽车进入弯道时并排而行，并展开竞争，但我们有工具基本上以正确的方式调整它，以适应2030年。"
detailEn: FIA explores DRS return alongside push-to-pass system for F1’s V8 engines
Speaking exclusively to Motorsport.com, FIA single-seater director Nikolas Tombazis reveals how the governing body could combine aerodynamic and electrical overtaking aids in 2030

Although the framework announced last week establishes the key elements of Formula 1’s next power unit regulations – a 2.1-litre turbocharged V8 with a significantly reduced electrical component – many details still need to be worked out over the coming months.
One of the key remaining questions is how to facilitate overtaking. For 2026, the FIA introduced overtake mode, but that is primarily a consequence of how incredibly complex this ruleset is.

For the current power unit regulations to work, the cars needed to have considerably less drag, which is why active aerodynamics were introduced with straight mode zones. With every driver able to open their front and rear wings, DRS disappeared as an overtaking aid and the FIA had to come up with an alternative, which turned out to be overtake mode.

The aim is to keep the whole concept considerably simpler for the next rules cycle. FIA single-seater director Nikolas Tombazis confirmed in an exclusive interview with Motorsport.com that straight mode (SM) zones will disappear and that the governing body is looking into more familiar concepts.

Behind the scenes, work is currently underway to establish what will be needed in terms of overtaking aids from 2030 onwards. The FIA is investigating several options, including a combination of push-to-pass and DRS.

"The electrical power in race conditions will definitely be more focused on push-to-pass and less on the energy recovery. Because the electrical part will be so much smaller in dimensions compared to the current engines, it means that all the regulations that relate to the energy usage will be either eliminated or hugely simplified," Tombazis told Motorsport.com.
"So yeah, it will be a fundamental point for overtaking, but we are still doing simulations about overtaking and close racing."

Those simulations are intended to establish exactly what is needed in terms of push-to-pass – a fixed number of seconds per race, as IndyCar has, or a different system – and also whether it needs to be combined with the return of DRS.
"If we need to have an addition of DRS to go together with some electrical part, then we will be more than happy to do that," Tombazis said.

"And just to say: we won't need to have SM mode zones anymore under the next regulations, and therefore we would retain the option to have a more DRS-like device to complement the electrical part to make sure that we have the right level of close racing."
Mechanics work on the DRS of Max Verstappen, Red Bull RB18
While simulations are ongoing, it has not yet been confirmed that push-to-pass and DRS will indeed be combined, although Tombazis did confirm that such a combination is now on the table.
"It could be, yes. I didn't say that it will be exactly like that, but yeah, there could be both [DRS and push-to-pass]."
Under the initial proposal, the electrical component would deliver up to 200kW, with 100kW available for normal use and the other 100kW for push-to-pass.
By potentially adding DRS to that, the FIA wants to strike the right balance: overtaking moves should ideally once again be completed in the braking zone rather than halfway down a straight.
"Yes, and what I'm saying is that DRS is a known solution for that. It's not like something we'd need to invent. We just need to see, A, if we need it, and B, how much of it we would need.

"We clearly don't want to create a situation where cars just fly past each other without any fight, we want there to be racing. We want cars to be entering corners next to each other and fighting, but we have the tools to basically tune it in the right way for 2030."

detailZh: 乔治·拉塞尔淡化对马克斯·维斯塔潘2024年那句著名的"撞墙"威胁的态度
回到卡塔尔，乔治·拉塞尔缓和了对马克斯·维斯塔潘2024年"撞墙"威胁的看法，并澄清了卡丁车相关的传闻
致梅赛德斯车迷。来自银箭车队的最新消息，包括F1新闻、车手动态、赛车研发以及来自布拉克利和布里克斯沃思的赛事分析。
两年前在卢赛尔国际赛道，一次例行的排位赛冷却圈让围场里暗涌的紧张情绪演变为公开对抗。如今，回到他与马克斯·维斯塔潘矛盾爆发的同一场地——而且就在拉斯维加斯站刚刚火上浇油几天之后——乔治·拉塞尔对那句曾促使他称这位荷兰车手为霸凌者的威胁，给出了明显更为平静的评价。
在周日卡塔尔大奖赛之前，拉塞尔独家接受了天空体育F1的马丁·布伦德尔的采访，回顾了2024年12月那场主导了F1阿布扎比赛季收官战的余波。当时，拉塞尔震惊了整个围场，他声称维斯塔潘在卡塔尔曾威胁要“故意冲着我撞过来，把我的脑袋撞到墙上”——这一指控促使拉塞尔宣称“多年来人们一直受到马克斯的霸凌”，并坚持认为“总得有人站出来对抗一个自认为凌驾于法律之上的人”。
维斯塔潘当时强烈否认了这一说法，他对荷兰媒体表示拉塞尔“又在夸大其词”，称他是“背后捅刀的人”和“就是个失败者”，并在离开时嘲讽了干事听证会：“也许下次，我会带上纸巾。”
两个赛季之后，拉塞尔对那番所谓威胁的激动情绪已经大幅降温。
“他就是这么办事的，”拉塞尔告诉布伦德尔，“我认识他够久了，所以我知道，那更多是一句玩笑话，我觉得。”
承担 2024 年闭门会议中所发生之事的责任
拉塞尔在赛事干事会议室内并未软化自己的说法。2024 年卡塔尔站排位赛中，维斯塔潘以 0.055 秒的优势力压拉塞尔夺得临时杆位，随后赛事干事认定这位红牛车手在冷却圈中不必要地慢速行驶并阻挡了梅赛德斯车手，因此给予他罕见的正赛发车位后退一位处罚。
维斯塔潘在周日的正赛中依然在起步时击败拉塞尔并最终夺冠，而拉塞尔仅获第四，但他离场时怒火中烧，称自己已经对这位对手“失去了全部尊重”，并指责对方“试图如此狠毒地算计别人”。
马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队，乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯
当布伦德尔问及拉塞尔在那场听证会上的姿态时，拉塞尔丝毫没有试图装无辜。
“嗯，我并不是想放过他，”拉塞尔承认道。“我的意思是，我进去时并没有说，‘那没关系。’”
这番坦率的承认恰好契合了这对竞争对手之间更广泛的模式——自拉塞尔驾驶梅赛德斯具备争胜能力的赛车以来，这种竞争每年都会爆发一次：
2023年巴库站：阿塞拜疆冲刺赛首圈2号弯的接触损坏了维斯塔潘的底板，并在封闭停车区引发了激烈的对峙。
2024年卡塔尔与阿布扎比：排位赛的罚退发车点燃了维斯塔潘“失去所有尊重”的炮轰，以及拉塞尔“撞墙”的反击。
2025年巴塞罗那：在比赛尾声安全车重启时切弯，并被红牛告知交还第四名后，维斯塔潘与拉塞尔发生严重碰撞——因此被罚10秒，名次跌至第10，并被记3个罚分，累计达到11分，距离禁赛一场仅差1分，随后维斯塔潘承认这次接触“本不该发生”。
2026年拉斯维加斯：练习赛中的接触与新的讥讽，随后维斯塔潘在拉斯维加斯大道赛道夺冠，而拉塞尔滑落至第九。
揭穿青训卡丁车出身的故事
连续四个赛季都有冲突记录在案，车迷们长期以来一直以为，两人之间的不和可以追溯到青少年卡丁车时期的竞争——就像维斯塔潘早年与夏尔·勒克莱尔或埃斯特班·奥康的较量那样。拉塞尔彻底否定了这种说法。
“我们在卡丁车时期其实并没有那么多次碰撞，”拉塞尔解释道。“他比我大一岁，所以我们在2011年只同场竞技过一次，之后显然他就快速推进了自己的职业生涯。”
马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队；乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯
记录也支持他的说法。尽管两人都在2011年赢得了KF3青少年组的重要头衔——维斯塔潘拿下WSK欧洲系列赛冠军，拉塞尔则夺得欧洲KF3锦标赛冠军——但在维斯塔潘迅速攀升单座赛车阶梯之后，两人的道路很快分开了，直到拉塞尔加入梅赛德斯，两人才真正成为赛道上的常客。
无论拉塞尔在镜头外提出怎样的休战，卢赛尔的泛光灯下两人很少能长时间相安无事。梅赛德斯在周五首节练习中率先确立节奏，安东内利领先拉塞尔，包揽前二，而维斯塔潘在周五晚间第二节练习前仅列第六——这为周日当地时间19:00大奖赛绿灯亮起时又一次头排之争埋下伏笔。
detailEn: George Russell softens stance on Max Verstappen’s infamous 2024 “in the wall” threat
Back in Qatar, George Russell softens his view on Max Verstappen's 2024 "in the wall" threat and debunks karting myths
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.

Two years ago at the Losail International Circuit, a routine qualifying cooldown lap turned a simmering paddock tension into open warfare. Now, returning to the exact venue where his feud with Max Verstappen detonated - and days after Las Vegas poured fresh gasoline on it - George Russell is offering a strikingly calmer verdict on the threat that once pushed him to brand the Dutchman a bully.

Speaking exclusively to Martin Brundle for Sky Sports F1 ahead of Sunday’s Qatar Grand Prix, Russell revisited the December 2024 fallout that dominated Formula 1’s season finale in Abu Dhabi. Back then, Russell stunned the paddock by alleging Verstappen had threatened in Qatar to "purposely go out of his way to crash into me, putting my f*****g head in the wall" - an accusation that prompted Russell to declare "people have been bullied by Max for years" and insist "somebody has to stand up to someone who thinks he's above the law".

Verstappen fiercely denied the claim at the time, telling Dutch media Russell was "exaggerating again", calling him a "backstabber" and "just a loser", and mocking the stewards’ hearing with a parting shot: "Maybe next time, I'll bring tissues."
Two seasons later, Russell’s temperature on that alleged threat has dropped considerably.
"That's how he [Verstappen] goes about his business," Russell told Brundle. "I've known him long enough that I know, again, that was a bit more of a laugh-away comment, I thought."
Owning what happened behind closed doors in 2024

Where Russell did not soften his story was inside the stewards’ room itself. In Qatar 2024 qualifying, Verstappen beat Russell to provisional pole by 0.055 seconds before stewards handed the Red Bull driver a rare one-place grid penalty for driving unnecessarily slowly on a cooldown lap and impeding the Mercedes.

Verstappen still beat Russell off the line to win Sunday’s race while Russell finished fourth, yet left fuming that he had "lost all respect" for a rival he accused of "trying to screw someone over that hard".
Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, George Russell, Mercedes
Asked by Brundle about his posture during that hearing, Russell made no attempt to play innocent.
"Well, I wasn't trying to let him off," Russell admitted. "I mean, I didn't go in there saying, 'That's fine.'"
That candid concession fits neatly into the broader pattern of a rivalry that has flared up once a year since Russell stepped into race-winning machinery at Mercedes:
Baku 2023: Opening-lap Turn 2 contact in the Azerbaijan Sprint damaged Verstappen’s floor and triggered a heated parc fermé confrontation.
Qatar & Abu Dhabi 2024: The qualifying grid drop sparked Verstappen’s "lost all respect" blast and Russell’s "in the wall" counterattack.

Barcelona 2025: After cutting a corner during a late safety car restart and being told by Red Bull to hand fourth back, Verstappen collided heavily with Russell—picking up a 10-second penalty that dropped him to 10th and three penalty points that left him on 11, one shy of a race ban, before Verstappen later admitted the contact "shouldn't have happened".
Las Vegas 2026: Practice contact and fresh barbs ahead of Verstappen’s Strip victory while Russell slid to ninth.
Debunking the junior-karting origin story

With four consecutive seasons of flashpoints on the ledger, fans have long assumed the bad blood traces back to teenage karting rivalries - much like Verstappen’s early battles with Charles Leclerc or Esteban Ocon. Russell shut that narrative down flat.
"We actually didn't have that many comings together in karting," Russell explained. "He's a year older than me, so we only raced together once in 2011, and then obviously he fast-tracked his career."
Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, George Russell, Mercedes

The record backs him up. Although both won major titles in the KF3 junior class in 2011 - Verstappen claiming the WSK Euro Series crown while Russell captured the European KF3 Championship - their paths quickly split once Verstappen jumped swiftly up the single-seater ladder, leaving the pair to become genuine on-track regulars only after Russell joined Mercedes.

Whatever truce Russell is offering off-camera, Losail’s floodlights rarely keep the pair apart for long. Mercedes set the early pace in Friday’s opening practice with Kimi Antonelli leading Russell in a 1-2 while Verstappen opened in sixth ahead of Friday night’s second session - setting the stage for another front-row collision course when Sunday’s Grand Prix goes green at 19:00 local time.

detailZh: 威廉姆斯为何在2025赛季F1成本上限中违规
FIA在2025年财务报告中发现约60万英镑超支后，威廉姆斯接受了罚款和空气动力学测试处罚
威廉姆斯在2025赛季违反F1成本上限规定，原因在于其财务团队与FIA裁决人员对相关成本的理解存在分歧，涉及车队重组时将资产转入新的有限责任合伙企业。
该格罗夫车队被认定在2025赛季成本上限中构成62.7万英镑的“轻微超支违规”，不过FIA承认，鉴于其对所涉成本的理解，这并非有意为之。
威廉姆斯随后接受了这一违规行为，处罚是空气动力学测试额度被削减1.5%，外加一笔未公开的罚款。
据车队领队詹姆斯·沃尔斯所说，威廉姆斯认为公司重组会被算作财务和法律活动，而这两类在2025年成本上限规则下都属于豁免项。国际汽联并不同意。
“我们现在已经把这件事彻底复盘了一遍，弄清楚本应该怎么做才不一样。显然，正因为这件事，我们本应该采取不同的做法，”沃尔斯表示。
“尽管规则在字面解释上并不清晰，但国际汽联的立场非常明确，就是以下这点：因为你们把合同从一个业务实体转移到了另一个业务实体，对他们来说这实际上就是采购，而采购属于被纳入的活动。”
“对我们来说，我们将其定义为一种财务和法律行为，因为它实际上就是拿一份合同并在上面改个名字。我能理解他们的解释，这也是我们接受违约的原因。”
“但我希望这能帮助你们理解，在那种情况下，为什么这其实是微妙之处，而非清晰明了。”
从英国公司注册处的日志来看，情况是这样的：威廉姆斯——自1977年以来一直以威廉姆斯大奖赛工程有限公司的名义运营——设立了一家新的有限责任合伙企业：威廉姆斯大奖赛工程服务有限责任合伙企业，并将价值2780万英镑的资产和负债转移到了这家新公司。
威廉姆斯大奖赛工程有限公司是该有限责任合伙企业中占99%份额的合伙人，而BCE GP有限责任公司——一家据信由多里尔顿资本管理的控股公司——则注册为占1%份额的少数合伙人。通过这样做，威廉姆斯大奖赛工程有限公司获得了一定程度的法律隔离，例如，通常不会对该有限责任合伙企业累积的任何债务承担责任。
沃尔斯表示，这是为了确保车队具备一定程度的未来适应性，也是威廉姆斯车队为跟上时代而需承担的一长串开支中的又一项。因此，62.7万英镑超支的大部分都用于组建新的有限责任合伙企业，以及将法律文件和供应合同转移至新公司。
他解释道：“威廉姆斯的公司架构自1977年以来基本没有变化，在现代环境下确实不太适用。”
“我们一开始就打算对国际汽联保持公开透明，全程都是这么做的，但我们认为这些成本属于公司重组，不应计入成本上限开支。”
“这是一次性的公司重组。真正感兴趣的人可以在我们的公司注册处报告中看到。你不会每年都重组公司。这种事一辈子做一次——理想情况下，只做一次。只不过这是一家有着50年历史的公司，在这方面不太适应需求。”
从根本上说，之前那里是一个单一的垂直结构，而从根本上拥有这种结构有很多缺点。
卡洛斯·塞恩斯，威廉姆斯，詹姆斯·沃尔斯，威廉姆斯
所以，你会看到围绕它已经创建了若干其他公司。这样只是更高效，但其中涉及的成本相当可观。
如果你想想作为一家企业你必须做什么，你可能会有——我是说，在我们的情况下，由于这一点，你不得不将接近2000份与各种供应商及其他方的合同从一家公司迁移到另一家公司。这是一项非常痛苦、漫长的任务。
“随之而来的还有一些法律方面的事务。同时，根据英国法律，你还必须完成一些合规工作。最终这是一个耗时颇多的过程——我们大概在六个月前启动了这一流程，这或许能让你了解它有多漫长。”
“但在此期间，我们不得不动用财务和法律人员，并临时加强人手以度过那段时间。”
沃尔斯解释说，车队直到国际汽联“大约三、四周前”联系车队、指出可能存在超支时，才知道违规一事——他再次表示，在管理机构说明立场之前，车队一直认为自己合规。
他表示，威廉姆斯不应因所受处罚而受到太大影响，并指出空气动力学测试削减1.5%（相当于两个月内约六小时风洞占用、1.2小时“吹风”时间、5次风洞运行和30次CFD几何测试）只是“小菜一碟”。
"换个角度看，发车格上一个位置相当于5%的空气动力学测试限制（ATR），而我们只有1.5%的差距。所以，这还不到三分之一的位置。
"而且我相当希望我们明年能做得更好，让自己在发车格上重新靠前。那将是15%，差不多在这个范围内。所以现实情况是，从大局来看，这只会是些小菜一碟。"
detailEn: Why Williams breached the 2025 F1 cost cap
Williams took a fine and an aero testing penalty after the FIA spotted a £600k overspend in 2025's financial reports

Williams' breach of Formula 1's cost cap regulations for the 2025 season was down to a difference in interpretation between its own finance team and the FIA adjudicators, relating to the company's restructure as the team moved assets into a new limited liability partnership.

The Grove squad was found to have committed a "minor overspend breach" of £627,000 in the 2025 cost cap, although the FIA conceded that this was unintentional given its interpretation of the costs involved.
Williams subsequently accepted the breach, which comes with a 1.5% penalty to its aerodynamic testing allowance, and an undisclosed fine.

According to team principal James Vowles, Williams believed that a company restructure would count as a financial and legal activity, both of which are classed as exemptions under the 2025 cost cap regulations. The FIA did not agree.
"We've gone back through it exactly now and what should we have done differently. And clearly, we should have done something differently as a result of it," Vowles stated.

"And although the regulations aren't clear in black and white in its interpretation, the FIA is very clear on their perspective, which is the following: because you've moved contracts from one business to the next, that effectively for them is procurement, which is an included activity.

"For us, we defined it as a financial and legal activity because it's literally taking a contract and changing a name on it. I can understand their interpretation, which is why we've accepted the breach.
"But I hope that helps you understand why it's subtleties, not clarity, really, in that circumstance."

As seen from its logs on Companies House, the scenario is that Williams - having traded as Williams Grand Prix Engineering Ltd since 1977 - had set up a new LLP: Williams Grand Prix Engineering Services LLP, and moved £27.8m worth of assets and liabilities into the new company.

WGPE Ltd is the 99% partner in the LLP, with BCE GP LLC - a holding company understood to be managed by Dorilton Capital - registered as the 1% minority partner. By doing this, WGPE Ltd has a degree of legal separation in place and, for example, will usually not be liable for any debts accrued by the LLP.

Vowles says that this is about ensuring a degree of future-proofing for the team, and another in a long line of expenses involved in bringing Williams up to date. As such, the majority of the £627,000 overspend has been tied up in incorporating the new LLP, and in transferring any legal documents and supply contracts to the new company.
"The company structure of Williams was largely unchanged from 1977, and wasn't really fit for purpose in a modern world," he explained.

"We went into it with every intention of being open and transparent with the FIA, which is what we held all the way throughout, but believed those costs, because it's company restructuring, not to be a cost cap expense.

"This is a one-off company restructuring that's taking place. You can, for those really interested, you can see it in our Companies House report. You don't restructure your company every year. You do it once every - well, ideally, you do it one-off. It's just it's a 50-year-old company that wasn't quite fit for purpose in that regard.
"Fundamentally, it's a single vertical structure is what was there previously, and there's many downsides to fundamentally having that.
Carlos Sainz, Williams, James Vowles, Williams
"So, you'll see there's a number of other companies have been created around it. It's just more efficient, but the costs involved in it are fairly significant.

"If you think about what you have to do as a business, you probably have – I mean, in our case, it was close to 2,000 contracts with various suppliers and otherwise that you have to migrate from one company to the next as a result of it. It's a very painful, lengthy task.

"There's some legal that goes with it. There's some compliance you have to do in UK law as a result of it as well at the same time. It was a process in the end that took - we initiated it probably around about six months, which probably gives you an idea as to how lengthy it is.
"But it was using finance and legal personnel for a period of which we had to bolster up to get us through that period."

Vowles explained that the team didn't know about the breach until the FIA contacted the team "about three, four weeks ago" to flag the potential overspend - again, feeling satisfied that it had been compliant until the governing body explained its stance.

He says that Williams shouldn't hurt too much with the applied penalty, noting that the 1.5% reduction in aero testing (which relates to about six hours of wind tunnel occupancy, 1.2 hours of 'wind on' time, 5 wind tunnel runs, and 30 CFD geometry tests in a two-month period) is "small beans".
"To put things in perspective, one position on the grid is 5% of ATR, and we've got a 1.5% delta. So, it's less than a third of a position.

"And I'm rather hoping that we do a better job next year and put ourselves back up the grid. And that would be 15%, something in that ballpark. So the reality is it's going to be small beans in the grand scheme of things."

items.originalTitle: George Russell says Lewis Hamilton offers a different example from Max Verstappen
items.summaryEn: In an exclusive Sky Sports F1 interview, George Russell contrasted Lewis Hamilton's "grace and dignity" with Max Verstappen's off-track style, while addressing his reignited Las Vegas feud with the four-time world champion.
detailZh: 乔治·拉塞尔称刘易斯·汉密尔顿提供了与马克斯·维斯塔潘不同的榜样。
乔治·拉塞尔在卡塔尔大奖赛前将刘易斯·汉密尔顿的“风度与尊严”与马克斯·维斯塔潘的场外风格进行了对比。
致梅赛德斯车迷。来自银箭车队的最新消息，包括F1新闻、车手动态、赛车研发以及来自布拉克利和布里克斯沃思的赛事分析。
在天空体育F1对马丁·布伦德尔的独家专访中——该专访于周五先行预告，完整版在周日卡塔尔大奖赛前播出——乔治·拉塞尔谈及他与四届世界冠军马克斯·维斯塔潘在拉斯维加斯再起的争执，并在两位F1当代巨人之间悄然划出了一道清晰可辨的对比。
拉塞尔说：“他（维斯塔潘）是一个冷酷无情的竞争者，我非常尊重这一点，但还有汉密尔顿，我和他做了三年队友，也看着他比赛了一辈子。而且显然，托托（沃尔夫，梅赛德斯车队领队）和（汉密尔顿）共事了12年，他同样是一个冷酷无情的竞争者，在方向盘后面绝对是猛兽，但显然也有着令人难以置信的价值观、风度和尊严。”
“而刘易斯是我真正敬仰的人，对于正在成长的孩子们来说，他是一个不可思议的榜样。但没有什么对与错，只有观点。每个人都有不同的观点，有些人喜欢车手A，有些人喜欢车手B，随着我长大，我不再让它对我产生那么大的影响。”
为什么汉密尔顿这个标杆具有真正的分量
这个比较之所以更有冲击力，是因为拉塞尔亲身经历过。从2022年到2024年，作为梅赛德斯队友，两人共同起步68次，拉塞尔和汉密尔顿在极其微小的差距上较量：比赛完赛次数34比34持平，总积分仅相差两分（汉密尔顿以697比695占优），而拉塞尔在排位赛中以39比29占优。即使在赛道上短暂出现紧张——比如2023年卢赛尔首圈的纠缠——这对组合也从未演变成公开的人身攻击。
上周末在拉斯维加斯，维斯塔潘的回应几乎截然不同。此前在第十四号弯的第三次练习中，两人发生轻微接触，拉塞尔公开批评了维斯塔潘的驾驶方式——这一事件导致这位红牛车手因驾驶行为不稳定而收到国际汽联的正式警告——随后维斯塔潘赢下了周六晚上的正赛，而拉塞尔则在比赛后段锁死轮胎，在與队友基米·安东内利的缠斗中撞上五号弯护栏，最终跌至第九名。
刘易斯·汉密尔顿，法拉利；乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯
赛后，维斯塔潘称拉塞尔“远低于我的水平”，并将他后段的失误称为“因果报应”。在接受荷兰广播公司Viaplay采访时，他更进一步表示：“他的言论激励不了我，因为他根本和我不是一个级别。整个赛季场下全是空谈，场上完全是个笑话。完美的因果报应。”
在与布伦德尔回顾这场风波的后续时，拉塞尔承认胜利让维斯塔潘掌握了话语权——同时强调了两人的性格分歧所在。
拉塞尔说：“事后我觉得这一切挺有意思的。但显然他赢了比赛，我跑了一场糟糕的比赛，而他能笑到最后，所以我确信他挺享受这一点的。”
布伦德尔将塞纳与舒马赫相提并论，以及一场激烈的第三名争夺战
布伦德尔在天空体育单独发表看法时表示，拉塞尔其实应该把维斯塔潘的敌意解读为一种尊重的信号。“某种程度上，我认为乔治应该把这当作一种赞美，因为马克斯甚至愿意对他发表评论，这说明他认为他足够快，”布伦德尔说。“他们两个人完全不是一路人，而这正是让世界继续运转的原因，不是吗？”
布伦德尔将维斯塔潘的威慑气质与自己赛车生涯中遇到的偶像车手相比较，补充道：“马克斯让我想起我职业生涯中经历过的其他车手，他们想稍微统治一下赛场。塞纳是我在三级方程式时遇到的一位，但他们采取的方式有微妙的不同。迈克尔·舒马赫，当我们在贝纳通车队做队友时；他想压制我，在赛道上相当有攻击性。”
尽管拉塞尔称赞汉密尔顿的标准，但这两位前队友在2026年的积分榜上仍然是直接竞争对手。继六月在巴塞罗那为法拉利赢得首胜——这是他职业生涯第106场胜利，拉塞尔紧随其后获得第二——汉密尔顿以267分进入卡塔尔站，在车手积分榜上排名第三，仅领先拉塞尔和兰多·诺里斯（264分）三分，落后第二名维斯塔潘（304分）37分。
周五在卢赛尔的首节练习至少给了拉塞尔一个早期提振：新加冕的冠军安东内利领跑梅赛德斯一二名，拉塞尔获得第二，维斯塔潘第六，汉密尔顿第八。2026赛季还剩两场比赛，拉塞尔已经明确了他选择的榜样——现在他需要周日的成绩来证明这一点。
detailEn: George Russell says Lewis Hamilton offers a different example from Max Verstappen
George Russell contrasts Lewis Hamilton's "grace and dignity" with Max Verstappen's off-track style before the Qatar GP
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.

In an exclusive Sky Sports F1 interview with Martin Brundle - previewed Friday ahead of its full broadcast before Sunday’s Qatar Grand Prix - George Russell addressed his reignited Las Vegas feud with the four-time world champion Max Verstappen by drawing a quiet, unmistakable contrast between two of Formula 1’s modern giants.

"He [Verstappen] is a ruthless competitor, and I massively respect that, but there's also Lewis Hamilton, who I've spent three years team-mates with and watched my whole life," Russell said. "And obviously Toto [Wolff, Mercedes' team principal] spent 12 years with [Hamilton], who is equally a ruthless competitor and absolute animal behind the wheel, but obviously has incredible values and grace and dignity.

"And Lewis is somebody who I really look up to and who is an incredible role model for young kids coming through. But there is no right or wrong; there's just opinions. Everyone has different opinions, and some people like driver A and some people like driver B, and as I've grown older, I don't really let it affect me as much."
Why the Hamilton benchmark carries real weight

The comparison hits harder because Russell lived it firsthand. Across 68 shared starts as Mercedes team-mates from 2022 through 2024, Russell and Hamilton fought on razor-thin margins: deadlocked 34–34 in race finishes, separated by just two total points (697 to 695 in Hamilton’s favour), with Russell holding a 39–29 edge in qualifying. Even when tensions briefly flared on track - such as their opening-lap tangle at Losail in 2023 - the pairing never descended into public character attacks.

Verstappen’s Las Vegas response last weekend could hardly have been more different. After Russell called out Verstappen’s driving following their Turn 14 final-practice brush - an incident that earned the Red Bull driver a formal FIA warning for erratic driving - Verstappen won Saturday night’s race while Russell locked up late and clipped the Turn 5 barrier battling team-mate Kimi Antonelli, falling to ninth.
Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari, George Russell, Mercedes

After the flag, Verstappen dismissed Russell as "so far below my level" and called his late off "karma". Speaking to Dutch broadcaster Viaplay, he went even further: "His comments don't motivate me, because he's nowhere near me. All talk off the track and a complete joke on it this season. Perfect karma."
Reflecting on the fallout with Brundle, Russell accepted that winning gives Verstappen the microphone - while emphasising where their personalities diverge.
"I found it all quite amusing afterwards. But obviously he won the race, I had a c**p race, and he's able to have the last laugh, so I'm sure he quite enjoyed that," Russell said.
Brundle’s Senna–Schumacher parallel, and a tight P3 fight

Weighing in separately on Sky Sports, Brundle suggested Russell should actually read Verstappen’s hostility as a sign of respect. "In a way, I think George should take it as a compliment that Max even cares to say something about him, because that means he thinks he's fast enough," Brundle said. "They're cut from a completely different cloth, those two, and that's what keeps the world spinning, isn't it?"

Comparing Verstappen’s intimidating streak to icons from his own racing career, Brundle added: "Max reminds me of other drivers I experienced in my career who wanted to try to dominate the field a little bit. Senna was one for me in Formula 3, but they did it in a subtly different way. Michael Schumacher, when I was team-mates at Benetton; he wanted to dominate me and was quite aggressive out on the race track".

Even as Russell praises Hamilton’s standards, the former team-mates remain direct rivals on the 2026 scoreboard. Following his maiden Ferrari victory in Barcelona in June - his 106th career win, with Russell standing right beside him in second - Hamilton enters Qatar third in the Drivers’ Championship on 267 points, just three clear of both Russell and Lando Norris (264), and 37 adrift of second-placed Verstappen (304).

Friday’s opening practice at Losail at least gave Russell an early boost: while newly crowned champion Antonelli paced a Mercedes 1-2, Russell finished second ahead of Verstappen in sixth and Hamilton in eighth. With two races left in 2026, Russell has made his choice of role model clear - now he needs Sunday’s result to back it up.

items.originalTitle: 100% wear in 15 laps – F1’s tyre challenges in Qatar far more extreme than Pirelli expected
items.summaryEn: Friday practice revealed higher-than-expected tyre wear and degradation, along with deep cuts caused by gravel, and Pirelli is evaluating whether to reduce its 27-lap limit per tyre set.
detailZh: 15圈就出现100%磨损——F1在卡塔尔面临的轮胎挑战远超倍耐力预期
周五练习显示轮胎磨损与性能衰退高于预期，并出现由砂石造成的深度割伤，倍耐力正评估是否下调每套轮胎27圈的使用上限
每年，卢赛尔国际赛道都是F1赛历中对唯一轮胎供应商倍耐力挑战最大的赛道。正因如此，本赛季再次设置了每套轮胎的最大使用圈数上限，此次为27圈。
这一上限基于倍耐力的赛前模拟，但实际情况比预期更为极端，倍耐力首席工程师西蒙内·贝拉如此解释。
“关键在于，颗粒化程度和磨损程度都高于我们在赛前预期。每次来到这里，这条赛道带给我们的惊喜都相当令人印象深刻，”贝拉微笑着说。
“我们注意到的是，在高油量运行期间，C3、C2和C1三种配方都出现了颗粒化。C1在机械耐受性方面稍强一些，颗粒化程度略有降低，而C2和C3的颗粒化程度为中度到重度。
“这加速了磨损，主要集中在两个区域：TWI 2和3区域，也就是基本朝向轮胎内侧胎肩的位置，然后是轮胎最外侧胎肩。我们有两个高磨损点，并且在高油量运行15圈后已经看到了100%磨损的情况。”
这些极端局部磨损的情况远早于规定的27圈上限出现，这意味着倍耐力正在评估是否需要进一步降低该上限。然而，答案未必是肯定的，因为除了磨损之外，轮胎性能衰退也证明高于预期。
“我们正在评估从第一节和第二节练习赛中选出的所有轮胎组。我们会检查它们，逐段分析，显然如果没有完整性问题，我们将保留27圈的限额。我们知道正赛中的颗粒化程度会降低，车队会做更多的管理来延长 连续驾驶圈数长度，”贝拉解释道。
“所以，如果它们没有引发任何完整性问题的增加，那么我们可以保留27圈。但这是我们实验室正在进行的一项分析，所以我们要弄清楚是继续用27圈还是不用。”
更高的退化程度可能会让现有的限制对倍耐力来说不那么令人担忧，因为贝拉预计车队不会一直推到每组27圈的允许上限。由于高退化导致车手每圈损失相当多的时间，提前进站可能更有利。
“你说的没错，退化程度确实高于我们在赛前预期的水平。我认为这将迫使车队更早进站，”贝拉在被 Motorsport.com 问及退化因素时说道。
“从我们最近做的分析来看，目前并不足以支撑跑27圈的长距离 stint。因为如果延长这么久，性能会明显下降，每圈大约掉0.2秒，这会迫使你换上新的轮胎并提前进站。所以基本上你可以把比赛分成三个更均衡的 stint，而不是27圈、27圈和3圈。”
当然，如果像去年那样早早出现安全车，后者仍然是一种风险。但即便在这种情况下，贝拉也不认为会出现27圈的 stint，而更可能是三次进站策略。
“是的，没错。根据我们的模拟，最优策略将是19圈、19圈、19圈。安全车甚至可能最终迫使他们转向三次进站。一次是为了安全车，之后还有两次，而不是只有一次。”
除了极高的磨损和最大 stint 长度之外，围场里还有一个与轮胎相关的话题：极高的胎压。前轮的最低胎压被设定为29psi，是整个赛季最高的。
尽管如此，这一点也仍在评估之中，因为赛道上有大量砾石，确实在轮胎上留下了痕迹。
“我们注意到轮胎上有砾石造成的割伤。我们看到多名车手冲出赛道，把大量砾石带到了赛车线上。我们看到其中一些割伤相当深，已经深入轮胎结构，”贝拉透露。
“也因此出现了红旗，而在这样的赛道上，这是一个额外的变量，可能在爆胎等方面引起我们的关注。”
实际操作上，这意味着倍耐力也在评估是否需要进一步调高胎压，若调高将创下现代F1时代的最高纪录。
“我们正在评估所有变量，如有必要，我们也会增加胎压。”
然而，倍耐力更倾向于不增加胎压，因为这样做可能会加剧颗粒化和局部磨损。
“我们现在的胎压接近30psi，所以基本上就是局部化了。你减小了轮胎的接地面积，基本上就是把磨损集中在一个点上，”贝拉解释道。
这些点目前是TWI 2、TWI 3和TWI 6。TWI代表胎面磨损指示器，其中2、3和6位于轮胎胎肩附近。进一步增加胎压会减小接地面积，可能将磨损集中在更小的区域，并使其向轮胎中心偏移。
“这就是为什么如果可能的话，我不会增加压力。但如果出于诚信原因我们必须这样做，那我们显然会进行评估。如果你继续增加压力，你会把颗粒化更多地推向内侧，更靠近中心。而TWI 6由于高载荷本来就承受着压力，所以基本上你有高横向载荷，并且你让轮胎的这个部分承受了很大压力。”
正如贝拉总结的那样：“一个接一个的惊喜。”
detailEn: 100% wear in 15 laps – F1’s tyre challenges in Qatar far more extreme than Pirelli expected
Pirelli is evaluating whether to reduce its 27-lap tyre limit after Friday practice revealed higher-than-expected wear and degradation, as well as deep cuts caused by gravel

Every year, the Lusail International Circuit represents the biggest challenge on the Formula 1 calendar for its sole tyre supplier, Pirelli. It is precisely for that reason that a maximum stint length is once again in place this season, with the limit this time set at 27 laps per set of tyres.
The latter was based on Pirelli's pre-event simulations, but in practice, the situation is proving even more extreme than expected, as Pirelli's chief engineer Simone Berra explained.

“The point is that the graining level and the wear level are higher than what we expected pre-event. It's quite impressive, the surprises that this circuit gives us every time we come here,” Berra smiled.

“What we have noticed is that during the high fuel running, the graining is on all three compounds, C3, C2 and C1. C1 is slightly more resilient in terms of mechanical resistance and the graining level is slightly reduced, while on C2 and C3 the graining level is moderate to heavy.

“That is accelerating the wear, mainly in two regions: the TWI 2 and 3 area, so basically towards the inside shoulder of the tyre, and then on the very outside shoulder of the tyre as well. We have two points of high wear and we have seen cases of 100% wear already during the high fuel running after 15 laps.”

Those cases of extreme localised wear occurred well before the prescribed 27-lap limit, meaning Pirelli is evaluating whether that limit needs to be reduced further. However, the answer is not necessarily yes, given that, in addition to the wear, tyre degradation is also proving higher than expected.

“We are evaluating all the sets that we have selected from FP1 and FP2. We are going to check them, to section them, and obviously if there is no integrity issue, we will keep the 27 laps. We know that the graining level will reduce for the race and the teams will do much more management to extend the stint length,” Berra explained.

“So, if they don't induce any increase in terms of integrity issues, then we can keep the 27 laps. But it's an analysis that is ongoing in our laboratory, so we are going to understand if we continue with 27 or not.”

Higher degradation could make the existing limit less of a concern for Pirelli, as Berra does not expect teams to push right up to the permitted limit of 27 laps per set. With drivers losing a considerable amount of time per lap due to the high degradation, it could be more beneficial to pit earlier.

“It's true what you said, so the degradation is higher than what we expected pre-event. And I think this will force the teams to stop earlier,” Berra said when asked about the degradation factor by Motorsport.com.

“I don't think it's really powerful at the moment, looking at the last analysis we have done, to do a 27-lap stint. Because if you extend for so long, there will be a clear drop in performance of 0.2 seconds per lap, and that forces you to take a new tyre and stop earlier. So basically you can divide the race into three more balanced stints instead of having 27, 27 and 3 laps.”

The latter is, of course, still a risk if there is an early safety car, as was the case last year. But even in that scenario, Berra does not expect to see 27-lap stints, but rather a three-stop strategy.

“Yes, correct. From our simulation, the optimum strategy will be 19, 19, 19. A safety car can even force them towards three stops in the end. One for the safety car and two later, instead of just one.”

In addition to the extremely high wear and the maximum stint length, there is another tyre-related talking point in the paddock: the extremely high tyre pressures. For the front tyres, the minimum pressure has been set at 29psi, the highest of the entire season.
Nevertheless, this is also still being evaluated, as the large amount of gravel on the track has quite literally left its mark on the tyres.

“We have noticed gravel cuts in the tyres. We've seen multiple drivers going off the track and bringing a lot of gravel onto the race line. We've seen some of those cuts quite deep into the construction,” Berra revealed.
“There was also a red flag due to this and it's something that, on a circuit like this, it's an additional variable that can create some attention from our side in terms of punctures, etc.”
In practical terms, this means Pirelli is also assessing whether the tyre pressures need to be increased even further, which would take them to a record high in the modern F1 era.
“We are evaluating all the variables and, if necessary, we will increase the pressure as well.”
However, Pirelli would prefer not to increase the tyre pressures, as doing so could exacerbate the graining and localised wear.
“We are almost running 30psi, so you basically localise it. You reduce the contact patch of the tyre and you localise the wear on a single point, basically,” Berra explained.

Those points are currently TWI 2, TWI 3 and TWI 6. TWI stands for tread wear indicator, with 2, 3 and 6 located towards the shoulders of the tyre. Increasing tyre pressure further would reduce the contact patch, potentially concentrating wear over a smaller area and shifting it towards the centre of the tyre.

“That's why I wouldn't increase the pressure, if possible. But if we have to do it for integrity reasons, then we’re obviously going to evaluate it. If you continue to increase the pressure, you move the graining more inboard, more towards the centre. And TWI 6 is under pressure anyway due to the high loads anyway, so basically you have high lateral loads and you stress this part of the tyre a lot.”
As Berra summed it up: “Surprise after surprise after surprise.”
